applyEnrichment.doc: Only the app's own actions write here (`allow(action)`).

askWho.doc: Asks app `app`'s `whoView` synchronously: whom it saw this run serve.

attach.doc: Names an uploaded blob `name`: state refers to it from now on.

beat.doc:
A timer (D34): records the tick's slot and the previous one. A tick fails while
its slot is within a `failBeats` window, and spins (until the node's deadline)
while its entry time is within a `stallBeats` window.

beats.doc: Every `beat` tick applied, oldest first (up to 1000).

bumpBoth.doc:
Calls `slowBump { key, spins }` on apps `a` and `b` together (`app::join!`): one
batch, which the node runs at once, so this run waits for the slower of the two, not
for both. Answers their counts; with `stall`, then runs until the node's deadline
stops it (a timeout is not logged, so a retry with the same key runs this again, and
the two calls replay their answers instead of counting twice).

captchaStatus.doc:
The state of challenge `challenge` in the captcha service `captcha`, read through
a synchronous `xcall.view`.

clear.doc: Removes every entry. Needs a fresh passkey confirmation.

detach.doc: Drops the name; the blob goes once nothing refers to it.

enrich.doc:
An action (D12): reads `key` through a view, sends it to the echo host with the
action's key and a secret, and writes what came back through `applyEnrichment`.

explode.doc: An action that fails at once with an app error (D22).

failBeats.doc: Makes the `beat` ticks of the next `n` slots (from this call's time) fail.

file.doc:
The blob named `name`, with what the node recorded of it; `null` if the name is
unknown or the blob was deleted.

fill.doc: Writes `n` keys (`fill-0` ..) of `size` bytes each, one `Inserted` event per new key.

findNotes.doc: The ids of the notes matching `text`, best first.

grantScope.doc:
The scope of the caller's grant (`env::grant_scope`): what the instance's managers set
on the person's grant, which the app would use to keep a guest to part of it; none for
a caller reaching the app another way.

init.doc:
`links`: the apps the node created with this instance, when its release creates
any (the node passes them; a client never does).

linked.doc:
The app linked under `name` now (`env::linked`): a member made with this instance or
an app its owner attached since.

links.doc: What `init` was told of the apps created with this instance.

newId.doc: A fresh unique id (D52); writes nothing.

onActionFailed.doc: The platform's report of an action that failed for good (D22).

onXcallFailed.doc: The platform's report of an xcall it dead-lettered (D29).

put.doc: Sets `key` without an event (for values over the 16 KiB event limit).

recordWho.doc: Stores under `key` who called and through which app (`env::caller`, `env::via`).

relayToSet.doc: Sends `set { key, value }` to app `app`, which takes no xcalls.

relayWho.doc: Sends `recordWho { key }` to app `app`: the target stores whom this run served.

remove.doc: Removes `key`; returns the value it had.

set.doc: Sets `key`; emits `Inserted` for a new key, `Updated` for an existing one.

setHuman.doc:
Sets `key` as `set` does, once the captcha service `captcha` (another app of the
organization) accepted `answer` to its challenge `challenge`: a synchronous xcall,
in this same call, before anything is written.

setHumanTurnstile.doc:
Sets `key` as `set` does, once the captcha service `captcha` accepted Cloudflare
Turnstile token `token`: the service checks it with Turnstile from its own call
(D76), all inside this one.

share.doc: A download grant for the blob named `name`, valid `ttl` seconds.

signGuestbook.doc:
A public method: anyone the instance lets in calls it, a visitor through a public
link included (whatever the instance's access). Stores who signed under `sign:<who>`
and answers who it was (`visitor:<link>:<key>` for a visitor).

slowBump.doc:
Draws 1 MiB of randomness from the host `spins` times, then counts one more under
`key` and answers the count: a slow target for `bumpBoth`. The host fills the bytes,
so the call takes wall time without spending its fuel. Also stores the run's time
(the entry's, stamped as the run starts) under `<key>@<count>`, so a test tells calls
that started together from calls that took turns.

spin.doc: Never returns: runs until the node's fuel or wall-clock budget stops it.

stallBeats.doc:
Makes `beat` ticks that run within `ms` of this call's time spin until they time
out; returns the app time the window ends at.

stamp.doc: The entry timestamp this call ran at (D19); writes nothing.

startEnrich.doc: Starts the `enrich` action for `key` (D17); returns its key.

timeNow.doc: The time a view sees: the last applied entry's timestamp (D19).

unitOf.doc:
The instance whose unit this app is a member of (`env::unit_of`): the one whose
release created it; none for an app created on its own.

whoView.doc: Who called and through which app, as `recordWho` stores it.

whoamiPublic.doc: A public view: who is calling (`visitor:<link>:<key>` for a visitor).

wipe.doc: The same as `clear`, under the brief's name.
